notes: Worst-frame callouts now have to be held, not glitched — the report's Worst frame photo and the clip's 'Needs work' jump point used to come from the single lowest-scoring frame, so one pose misread could send you to fix a fault that never happened. A low frame only counts once the next frame is low too, and a lone dip with good frames around it is skipped, so the fault you get sent to fix is one you actually held.
